slides.sub: Five quick checks before the festive rush. Swipe and tick them off.

slides.label: Opening hours
slides.fx: Say when you're open, when you're closed and when you're back. It's one of the first things people look for in December.

slides.label: Order dates
slides.fx: If you post products, show your last order date for Christmas delivery on product pages and at checkout.

slides.label: Mobile
slides.fx: Festive shopping happens in queues and on sofas. Open your site on your own phone and try to buy something.

slides.label: Gift ideas
slides.fx: A simple gift guide page or collection helps undecided shoppers choose faster, and choose you.

slides.label: Google
slides.fx: Update your Google Business Profile with the same festive hours, so nobody turns up to a locked door.

slides.sub: Websites, Shopify stores and brands for small businesses, from a friendly Nottingham studio.
